description: A call inside a loop body feeding a loop-carried accumulator, with A editing the callee and B an independent variable. Combines the two mechanisms no other fixture combines: loop carriage (which orders the body against the backedge) and the interprocedural layer (the edit is in the callee, so the scope must reach main through the formal-out). Clean, and the demand-driven run reaches the same verdict via the Type-0 certificate.
